summary: Learn ABC analysis, safety stock, reorder points, and inventory KPIs in a practical five-day course. Explore the outline and plan your training.
lede: Inventory management training helps planning and operations professionals set stock policies that balance availability, service needs, and working capital. Learners practise ABC-XYZ segmentation, reviewing forecast error, calculating reorder points and safety stock, and using inventory KPIs to guide replenishment and stock-control actions. These methods connect decisions across purchasing, warehousing, and customer service.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who make, analyse, or approve inventory decisions across purchasing, planning, warehousing, and operations. It suits foundation-level learners who need structured methods for day-to-day stock control and planning.
prerequisites: Basic familiarity with purchasing, stock records, warehouse operations, or supply chain workflows is useful. No coding or programming is required. Bring an example of an inventory planning challenge if available; do not include confidential company data.
